z-m-11-01.title: Isixa sikhulu kunenani labafundi. Ingaba itheyibhile ayilunganga?
z-m-11-01.topic: Izixa zetheyibhile nenani labantu abaphandwe (idatha apho umntu omnye aphawule ngaphezu kwexesha elinye)
z-m-11-01.goal: Xa isixa setheyibhile sahluke kwinani labafundi abaphandwe, musa ukugqiba ukuba itheyibhile ayilunganga, kodwa yitsho ukuba yintoni enye ekufuneka uyazi njengendlela yophando, uze ulungise isigqibo sakho ngolwazi olutsha.
z-m-11-01.material:
Iklasi 3 yeBanga 4 inabafundi abangama-28. Baphande 'indawo abafuna ukuya kuyo kuhambo lwesikolo' baza benza itheyibhile engezantsi. Amanani kwitheyibhile linani labafundi abafake ○ kuloo ndawo.

| Indawo | Imyuziyam | Iziko lezilwanyana | Iziko lenzululwazi | Ipaki yolonwabo | Isixa |
| Abafundi (inani labantu) | 12 | 10 | 9 | 7 | 38 |

U-Jia wathi, "Isixa sikhulu i-38 kodwa iklasi yethu inabafundi abangama-28. Itheyibhile ayilunganga!" (Itheyibhile ibhalwe ngamagama, ngoko akukho mfanekiso. Imigca yetheyibhile, ukusuka ngaphezulu, yindawo nenani labafundi.)

z-m-11-02.title: Indlela ka-Minseo yokufunda i-pictograph: yintoni ebonakala ingaqhelekanga?
z-m-11-02.topic: Oko umfanekiso omkhulu nomncinci bamele kona kwi-pictograph
z-m-11-02.goal: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba kwi-pictograph apho imifanekiso yobukhulu obahlukileyo inamaxabiso ahlukileyo, ukuthelekisa ngokubala imifanekiso kuphela kunokungalunganga, uze uthi imiqathango apho ukuthelekisa ngokubala kulungile.
z-m-11-02.material:
Inani leesonka ezithengiswe ngosuku kwii-bakery ezine zommandla libonakaliswa kwi-pictograph. Umfanekiso omnye omkhulu wesonka umele iisonka ezili-10, kwaye umfanekiso omnye omncinci wesonka umele isonka esi-1. Akukho mfanekiso, ngoko ibhalwe ngamagama.

| I-bakery | Imifanekiso emikhulu yesonka | Imifanekiso emincinci yesonka |
| 가 | 3 | 4 |
| 나 | 2 | 9 |
| 다 | 4 | 0 |
| 라 | 3 | 7 |

U-Minseo wayifunda le grafu waza wayishwankathela kwimigca emithandathu engezantsi.

z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.5: 6. I-bakery enemifanekiso emininzi yi-bakery 나 (11), ngoko i-bakery 나 ithengise isonka esininzi.

z-m-11-07.title: Ukwenza kwakhona iinketho ezikuphando lweencwadi ukuze zingagqubani
z-m-11-07.topic: Ukwenza izinto zophando (iinketho): akukho kugqubana nakungashiyi nto
z-m-11-07.goal: Cinga ukuba uzifunda njani iziphumo xa iinketho kuphando zigqubana okanye zishiya izinto, uze wenze wena iinketho ezingagqubaniyo kwaye ezivumela wonke umntu ukuba akhethe enye.
z-m-11-07.material:
IKlasi 3 yeBanga 4 yaphanda 'uhlobo lweencwadi ababefuna ukuzifunda' ukuthenga iincwadi ezintsha zethala leencwadi leklasi. Umntu ngamnye ukhethe enye kuphela, kwaye bonke abafundi abangama-27 baphendule. Iinketho zophando neziphumo zezi zilandelayo.

| Ukhetho | Iincwadi zamabali eentsomi | Iincwadi zamahlaya | Iincwadi zebhayografi | Iincwadi zamabali | Iincwadi zesayensi |
| Abafundi (inani labantu) | 8 | 9 | 3 | 5 | 2 |

(Uphando lwathi iincwadi zamabali eentsomi ziincwadi ezinamabali acingelwayo, kwaye iincwadi zamabali ziincwadi ezinesicwangciso. Iincwadi zembali neencwadi zemibongo zazingekho phakathi kweenketho.)
z-m-11-07.thinking.1: Ukusebenza indlela ukugqubana okuchaphazela ngayo ukufunda iziphumo
z-m-11-07.prereq.1: Ukwazi umahluko phakathi kwe-'ukukhetha enye kuphela' kunye ne-'ukukhetha ezininzi'
z-m-11-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iingxaki ezinokuvela kwiinketho zolu phando.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngencwadi enye ehambelana nazo zombini iincwadi zamabali eentsomi neencwadi zamabali. Ucinga ukuba umfundi uya kukhetha eyiphi?
z-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ngeentlobo ezimbalwa ezongezelelweyo zeencwadi abantu abafuna ukuzifunda, ujonge ukuba zikho na ezingahambelaniyo naphi kwiinketho.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.a: Zikho iinketho ezi-5, ngoko kunzima kubafundi ukukhetha enye kuphela
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.a: 5 ayininzi. Ingxaki asinani kodwa bubudlelwane phakathi kweenketho.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.b: Iincwadi zamabali eentsomi neencwadi zamabali ziyagqubana, ngoko ibhokisi abafundi abayikhethayo inokwahluka kumfundi nomfundi
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.b: Ufumene ukuba iinketho ezimbini ziyafana, ngoko abantu bangakhetha ngokwahlukileyo incwadi enye.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.c: Iincwadi zamahlaya ziphakathi kweenketho, ngoko uphando luba lungachanekanga
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba incwadi iphakathi kweenketho akwenzi uphando lube lungalunganga. Cinga ukuba iinketho ziyagqubana okanye zishiya into.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.d: Umfundi ofuna ukufunda iincwadi zembali okanye iincwadi zemibongo akanakho ukhetho aluphuculayo
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.d: Ufumene ukuba kukho abafundi abafuna uhlobo olungekho kuphando. Baphendule, kodwa basenokungakwazi ukufaka iingcinga zabo.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.explain: Ukuba iinketho ziyagqubana, abafundi abanengcinga efanayo bangangena kwiibhokisi ezahlukeneyo, kwaye ukuba ezinye iintlobo ziswelekile, abo bafundi kufuneka bazinyanzele ukukhetha ibhokisi esondeleyo. Inani elikhulu leenketho okanye uhlobo oluthile oluquliweyo akuyongxaki.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.prompt: UJunho uthethe njengoko kungezantsi emva kokubona iziphumo zophando. Ngowuphi umgca ongaqhelekanga? (Amanani emigca aqala kwi-1.)
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba phakathi kwabafundi aba-5 abakhethe iincwadi zamabali, ngaba kunokubakho abafundi abathanda neencwadi zamabali eentsomi nabo.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola 'ukuba umfundi omnye angangena kabini xa udibanisa okanye uthelekisa iibhokisi'.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.0: 1. Umntu ngamnye ukhethe enye kuphela, ngoko 27, isixa sawo onke amanani etheyibhileni, linani labafundi abaphendulileyo.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.1: 2. Iincwadi zamahlaya, ngabafundi aba-9, yibhokisi ekhethwe ngabantu abaninzi.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.2: 3. Abafundi abangu-3 beencwadi zebhayografi nabangu-2 beencwadi zesayensi ngabafundi abahlukeneyo, ngoko ndawonye ngabangu-5.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.3: 4. Abafundi aba-8 bakhethe iincwadi zamabali eentsomi, ngoko abafundi aba-8 kuphela abathanda iincwadi zamabali eentsomi.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.4: 5. Abafundi abakhethe iincwadi zamahlaya ngu-1 ngaphezulu kunabafundi abakhethe iincwadi zamabali eentsomi.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.explain: Umgca 4 awuqhelekanga. Phakathi kwabafundi aba-5 abakhethe iincwadi zamabali, kusenokubakho nabafundi abathanda iincwadi zamabali eentsomi, ngoko abafundi abangaphezulu kwe-8 basenokuthanda iincwadi zamabali eentsomi. Kuba umntu ngamnye ukhethe enye kuphela, ungadibanisa iibhokisi njengakwimigca 1 no-3.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.prompt: Yenza kwakhona iinketho kuphando. Bhala ezi-5 okanye ngaphantsi, uzenze ukuze zingagqubani ukuze umntu ngamnye akhethe enye kuphela, uqinisekise ukuba kukho indawo yomfundi ngamnye ukukhetha. Emva koko bhala isizathu sokuba uzahlule ngaloo ndlela kwizivakalisi ezinye okanye ezimbini.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala gqiba umgangatho omnye wokwahlula iincwadi (umzekelo, umxholo okanye imo), ubhale iinketho ngaloo mgangatho.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngamagama amathathu eencwadi uvavanye omnye ngomnye ukuba ungena kwenye kuphela yeenketho.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uvavanye ngemizekelo ukuba ikhona incwadi ehambelana neenketho ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu ngaxeshanye?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba likho indawo yomfundi ofuna ukufunda iincwadi zembali okanye iincwadi zemibongo ukukhetha?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ukuba wongeze ibhokisi efana ne-'ezinye iincwadi', ngaba ucinge ukuba loo bhokisi isenokuba nkulu kakhulu?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.0: Iinketho: iincwadi zamabali (kuquka iincwadi zamabali eentsomi), iincwadi zamahlaya, iincwadi zesayensi, imbali neebhayografi, ezinye iincwadi. Iincwadi zamabali eentsomi neencwadi zamabali ziyagqubana, ngoko ndazidibanisa zaba yinye, kwaye ndongeze 'ezinye iincwadi' ukuze abafundi abafuna ukufunda iincwadi ezingahambelani naphi bakwazi ukukhetha.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.1: Iinketho: iinoveli, iincwadi zamahlaya, iincwadi zolwazi (isayensi nembali), iincwadi zemibongo, iibhayografi. Ndahlula ngomxholo weencwadi ukuze incwadi ingabi kwiibhokisi ezimbini. Kuba akukho bhokisi zigqubanayo, ndicinga ukuba abafundi baya kuphela bekhetha ibhokisi enye.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yahlula ngomgangatho womxholo kwaye yahlola ukuba azigqubani, kodwa ayizange ithethe ngo-'kushiya'.
